Know before you order

The details
make the difference.

What is included in the sheet set?

One fitted sheet, one flat sheet, and four pillowcases. Pillows are sold separately.

Which sizes are listed?

Queen, King, and California King. Listed fitted-sheet sizes: Queen 60 × 80 inches, King 76 × 80 inches. The line also fits California King. Confirm pocket depth and pillowcase dimensions when calling.

What is the fabric composition?

2000 thread count. Ask for the package fiber label if you need the exact fiber composition.

Can I add pillows?

Yes. Cool Comfort Bamboo Pillows are sold separately: $40 per Queen set and $50 per King set. Ask how many pillows come in a set when you call.

How do I pay and receive my order?

Orders are arranged by phone. Sets ship daily from stock held in-house, sourced from a nearby distributor. Shipping is a flat $12 per sheet set. We recommend ordering two or more sets in one box. All sales are final — no returns, so confirm size and color before paying. No online payment is collected on this page.

How should I care for my set?

Follow the care label on the exact set you receive. Ask about washing and drying instructions before ordering if you have specific requirements.
